scope: Official website and admissions resources for the 14 Okaloosa County FL and 10 Baldwin County AL NCES 2023-24 private-school records. Current websites do not establish current enrollment, accreditation or availability. No coordinate overrides were inferred.

schools.name: Bayshore Christian School
schools.evidence: The official contact page identifies the grammar campus at 316 Presbyterian Drive in Fairhope, matching the NCES location, and separately identifies the Logic & Rhetoric campus in Daphne. The official navigation links the admissions process page.
schools.campusNote: The Fairhope address is the grammar school campus. Logic & Rhetoric has a separate campus at 8740 Convocation Lane, Daphne, AL 36526. Confirm the campus for the student's program.

schools.name: Bayside Academy
schools.evidence: The official contact page publishes 303 Dryer Avenue, Daphne, AL 36526, matching the directory. The school's admissions navigation links How to Apply.

schools.name: Central Christian School
schools.evidence: The official application page identifies Central Christian School at 17395 State Highway 104, Robertsdale, AL 36567, with phone 251-947-5043, and lists 2026-27 application information.

schools.name: Marietta Johnson School Of Organic Education
schools.evidence: The school's contact page identifies 8 Marietta Drive, Fairhope, AL 36532, and 251-928-9347. Its application and programs pages describe the current admission process and program offerings.
schools.campusNote: The official site lists specific 2026-27 programs and a waitlist for older students. Confirm current grade availability directly; the directory grade span is historical.

schools.name: Snook Christian Academy
schools.evidence: The official home page publishes 18930 County Road 28, Foley, AL 36535, and 251-989-2333. Its admissions link targets the admissions section of the school page.

schools.name: South Baldwin Christian Academy
schools.evidence: The official admissions page identifies 6900 Highway 59, Gulf Shores, AL 36542, and 251-968-1230, and describes the admission and visit process.

schools.name: St Benedict Catholic School
schools.evidence: The established official site identifies 12786 Illinois Street, Elberta, AL 36530, and 251-986-8143. Its August 16, 2026 announcement names stbenedictschool.com as the new official site. The established site still exposes its admissions guidelines.
schools.campusNote: The school announced a new website, stbenedictschool.com, on August 16, 2026. The new domain returned HTTP 403 during this check, so the readable official website and admissions guidelines are retained as resources.
schools.websiteVerification: Established official site readable; new domain ownership verified through the school's announcement, but new content was unavailable.

schools.name: St Patrick Catholic School
schools.evidence: The official school site identifies 23070 Highway 59 North, Robertsdale, AL 36567, and 251-947-7395. Its admissions navigation links the admission policy page.

schools.name: The Renaissance School Of The Eastern Shore
schools.evidence: The official enrollment page identifies The Renaissance School in Daphne and publishes 10526 County Road 64, Daphne, AL 36526, with 251-990-0041. This differs from the 2023-24 NCES Austin Road location.
schools.campusNote: The school currently publishes 10526 County Road 64, Daphne, AL 36526. The dated directory lists 25870 Austin Road, Suite 1. Confirm the current campus before visiting.

schools.name: Uphc Small Steps Learning Center
schools.evidence: The official NCES record identifies UPHC Small Steps Learning Center at 421 2nd Avenue, Foley, AL 36535, with 251-943-6299. No official school-owned website or admissions page was confirmed in this check.

schools.name: Advanced Sacred Hope Academy
schools.evidence: The official Mary Esther school website links its 2026-27 registration to Gradelink, whose enrollment page identifies Advanced Sacred Hope Academy. The official contact page explicitly labels its alternate address as a mailing address.
schools.campusNote: The official contact page lists 124 E Miracle Strip Parkway, Suite 503, Mary Esther as a mailing address. It does not verify that this is a replacement physical campus for the directory's 144 US Highway 98 location. Confirm the campus directly.

schools.name: Cinco Christain School
schools.evidence: The official Cinco Christian School application page publishes 26 Yacht Club Drive, Fort Walton Beach, FL 32548, and 850-243-7515, matching the NCES record despite the directory's name spelling.

schools.name: Emerald Coast Autism Center
schools.evidence: The official website identifies 80 College Boulevard East, Niceville, FL 32578, and 850-279-3000. Its enrollment FAQ directs families to the linked contact page to begin enrollment.

schools.name: First United Methodist School
schools.evidence: The official 2024-25 family handbook identifies First United Methodist School as a ministry at 103 First Street SE, Fort Walton Beach. The sponsoring church's current site retains that address; no current school admissions page was verified.
schools.campusNote: The available school handbook is dated 2024-25. The website is the sponsoring church's site; confirm current school operation, programs and admissions directly.
schools.websiteVerification: Official sponsoring-church resource verified; current school admissions not confirmed.

schools.name: Global Beacon School
schools.evidence: The official site identifies Global Beacon School in Crestview with 850-612-5901, matching NCES. Its Request a Tour link opens the contact page; its resources page includes school and tuition documents.

schools.name: Lakewood Christian School
schools.evidence: The official page identifies 6250 Old Bethel Road, Crestview, FL 32536, and 850-683-1114. It describes admission by interview and directs prospective families to call to schedule a visit.

schools.name: Lotus Learning & Arts Center
schools.evidence: The official Lotus site publishes 74 3rd Street, Shalimar, FL 32579. Its 850-226-4988 phone matches the NCES Lotus Learning & Arts Center record at the older Fort Walton Beach address. No dedicated admissions page was confirmed.
schools.campusNote: The official site currently publishes 74 3rd Street, Shalimar, FL 32579. The dated directory lists 419 Racetrack Road NW, Fort Walton Beach. Confirm the current campus and programs directly.

schools.name: Montessori Learning Center
schools.evidence: The official Montessori Learning Center admissions page identifies 28 Miracle Strip Parkway SW, Suite 2, Fort Walton Beach, FL 32548, and 850-244-1775, matching the NCES school.

schools.name: Rocky Bayou Christian School
schools.evidence: The official Niceville campus page identifies 2101 Partin Drive North, Niceville, FL 32578. The school's official admission process applies across its campus network.
schools.campusNote: This is the Niceville Partin Drive campus. The Keep and Crestview have separate campus pages and addresses; confirm the campus for the student's program.

schools.name: Rocky Bayou Christian School - Crestview, Fl
schools.evidence: The official Crestview campus page identifies 951 South Ferdon Boulevard, Crestview, FL 32536, and 850-306-3459. Both Crestview NCES records share this address; the school site describes one Crestview campus.
schools.campusNote: NCES records 00260819 and A2300878 share this Crestview address. They link to the same verified campus and do not establish two separate physical campuses.

schools.name: Rocky Bayou Christian School Crestview
schools.evidence: The official Crestview campus page identifies 951 South Ferdon Boulevard, Crestview, FL 32536, and 850-306-3459. Both Crestview NCES records share this address; the school site describes one Crestview campus.
schools.campusNote: NCES records 00260819 and A2300878 share this Crestview address. They link to the same verified campus and do not establish two separate physical campuses.

schools.name: Rocky Bayou Christian School, The Keep
schools.evidence: The official Keep campus page identifies 1000 37th Street, Niceville, FL 32578, and describes the middle-school campus. This matches the separate NCES Keep record.
schools.campusNote: The Keep is a separate Niceville campus from the Partin Drive site. Confirm the campus for the student's program.

schools.name: St Mary Catholic School
schools.evidence: The official school site identifies 110 Robinwood Drive SW, Fort Walton Beach, FL 32548, and 850-243-8913. Its public admissions page describes the admissions process; the diocesan school finder corroborates the school identity.

schools.name: St Paul Christian School
schools.evidence: The official school admissions page identifies 1407 East John Sims Parkway, Niceville, FL 32578, and 850-678-1298, matching the NCES record.
